# Cncf Gardener Reviewer

Review Gardener using its official documentation and repository in the Platform / Certified Kubernetes - Installer category. The Gardener implements automated management and operation of Kubernetes clusters as a service and aims to support that service on multiple  Cloud providers.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
